startline_value.headline: A race website concept built around registration intent — not just a prettier homepage.
startline_value.intro: StartLine Sites reorganizes the information runners need before they register: date, location, distance, course details, schedule, policies, and the official registration link. The goal is to reduce friction, surface trust signals, and make the next click easier to find on mobile and desktop.
improved: Reduced runner friction by placing key race facts near the registration path.
Surfaced trust signals from configured distances, schedule details, and FAQs when available.
Made registration CTAs easier to find on mobile and desktop with measurement-ready registration-click tracking.
paid_includes: Mobile-first implementation shaped around the runner registration path.
SEO-ready page structure and event metadata for clearer discovery and sharing.
Registration-click tracking setup so runner intent can be measured after launch.
No registration-growth guarantees — just a clearer, faster, more measurable path from runner interest to registration click-through.

story.title: About Beat Beethoven 5K
paragraphs: Classic 107.3 Beat Beethoven 5K brings runners and walkers to Creve Coeur Lake Park for a music-forward community event.
The 5K challenge is simple and memorable: finish before the end of Beethoven’s famous Symphony No. 5, roughly 33 minutes.
The event supports Classic 107.3 - Radio Arts Foundation, the community-supported arts and classical radio station in St. Louis.

faqs.question: Where does the race take place?
faqs.answer: Race options include Creve Coeur Lake Park at 13725 Marine Ave in Maryland Heights, MO.

faqs.question: What is the Beat Beethoven challenge?
faqs.answer: Race details explain the goal is to finish before Beethoven’s Fifth Symphony ends, about 33 minutes.

faqs.question: What event options are listed?
faqs.answer: Beat Beethoven 5K Run/Walk, Missy Mazzoli Mile, and Virtual 5K Run/Walk.
